technical_complexity.rationale: Reading manufacturing drawings and producing cost models is a hard applied machine learning problem for a two person team in 2022, but not research-grade.

defensibility.rationale: Established vendors held cost databases and customers; a new entrant has little structural advantage beyond execution and the quality of its models.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No sources show an incumbent acting on Sculpt. The company later appears to have changed its focus toward aviation MROs.

market_need_then: Procurement teams rely on should-cost estimates to negotiate part prices, and an industry source says supplier quotes for the same part vary by as much as plus or minus 40 percent. Evidence specific to the founding date was not found.

branding.domain_note: A website could not be found; the YC record lists none and a cost-estimating domain (sculptcosting.com) appears in one directory only.

brand_strength.rationale: No site, press or community found; search results are filled with unrelated companies called Sculpt.

outcome_analysis: Sculpt is a two person Summer 2022 company listed as active. Its founder bio describes AI should-cost analysis for manufacturers while the current tagline says world models for aviation MROs, which suggests a change of focus, but no source dates or explains it. No funding, customers, website or exit were found, so no outcome judgment is possible.
notes: The company has no website in the directory record, so the website requirement is met by a dead or absent site note.
